constraints: The generated request is in PKCS format, suitable for submission directly to a certificate authority (e.g. Verisign).

overloadMerges.note: certifRequest is the BLOB the command fills in with the generated request (out), not an in parameter.

params.name: certifRequest
params.description: BLOB receiving the generated certificate request

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Generates, in certifRequest, a PKCS-format certificate request built from privKey and the code/name identity arrays, for submission to a certificate authority.
